assignments.title: Microservices Deployment on Kubernetes Cluster
assignments.description: Implement a containerized 3-tier web application using Docker, construct Kubernetes deployment and service manifests with load balancing, and attach a documented architecture PDF.

assignments.title: Query Optimization & B-Tree Index Analysis
assignments.description: Analyze query execution plans for complex joins over 1M records. Contrast clustered vs non-clustered indexing and evaluate execution timing before and after index tuning.

submissions.feedback: Exceptional comparative analysis and detailed EXPLAIN query plan graphs. Very well done.

assignments.title: Neural Network Backpropagation from Scratch
assignments.description: Implement a 3-layer neural network with forward pass, cross-entropy loss, and backpropagation using only NumPy. Test on the MNIST handwritten digits dataset.

assignments.title: Wireshark Packet Analysis & TLS Handshake Inspection
assignments.description: Capture and dissect packets during an HTTPS handshake. Explain Diffie-Hellman key exchange, cipher suite negotiation, and symmetric session key generation.

submissions.feedback: Great cryptographic breakdown and clear packet flow screenshots.

messages.subject: Feedback on Database Query Optimization Paper
messages.text: Hello Alex, I reviewed your indexing case study. Your analysis on composite indexes was very sharp. Are you interested in presenting this at the upcoming student research symposium next month?

messages.subject: Re: Feedback on Database Query Optimization Paper
messages.text: Thank you so much, Dr. Jenkins! I would be thrilled to present it. Could I drop by during your office hours on Wednesday at 2:30 PM to discuss the presentation slides?

messages.subject: Re: Feedback on Database Query Optimization Paper
messages.text: Yes, 2:30 PM Wednesday works perfectly. Please bring a draft of your slide deck or outline. See you then!

messages.subject: Kubernetes Assignment Cluster Configuration Query
messages.text: Hi Professor Chen, for Assignment 1, should we configure the Ingress controller with TLS certificates or will standard HTTP NodePort be sufficient for evaluation?

messages.text: Standard HTTP ingress is acceptable for base marks, but configuring a self-signed TLS secret earns 2 bonus points on security hardening.
